```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false

library(tidyverse)
library(sf)
library(geobr)
library(leaflet)
library(DT)
library(reactable)
library(plotly)
library(crosstalk)
library(scales)
# library(bslib) # en este formato no es necesario
library(here)

# ── Carga de datos ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
df_elections      <- readRDS(here("09_tutorial/data/elections.rds"))
df_finance        <- readRDS(here("09_tutorial/data/finance.rds"))
df_transfers      <- readRDS(here("09_tutorial/data/transfers_combined.rds"))
df_socioeconomic  <- readRDS(here("09_tutorial/data/socioeconomic.rds"))
df_municipalities <- readRDS(here("09_tutorial/data/municipalities.rds"))

sf_municipios <- geobr::read_municipality(year = 2020, showProgress = FALSE) |>
  mutate(id_municipio = as.character(code_muni))

sf_estados <- geobr::read_state(year = 2020, showProgress = FALSE) |>
  mutate(sigla_uf = abbrev_state) |>
  st_transform(crs = 4326)

# ── Preparación ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
df_socio_2020   <- df_socioeconomic |> filter(year == 2020)
df_finance_2020 <- df_finance       |> filter(year == 2020)

df_transf_2020 <- df_transfers |>
  filter(year == 2020) |>
  group_by(id_municipio) |>
  summarise(transfer_total = sum(transfer_amount, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

# % votos por partido en 2020
df_votos_totales <- df_elections |>
  filter(year == 2020) |>
  group_by(id_municipio) |>
  summarise(total_votos_mun = sum(total_votes, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

# PT en particular (para el mapa por defecto)
df_voto_pt <- df_elections |>
  filter(year == 2020, sigla_partido == "PT") |>
  left_join(df_votos_totales, by = "id_municipio") |>
  mutate(pct_pt = round(total_votes / total_votos_mun * 100, 1)) |>
  select(id_municipio, pct_pt)

# Tabla maestra de municipios
df_municipios_completo <- df_municipalities |>
  left_join(df_socio_2020,   by = "id_municipio") |>
  left_join(df_finance_2020, by = "id_municipio") |>
  left_join(df_transf_2020,  by = "id_municipio") |>
  left_join(df_voto_pt,      by = "id_municipio")

# SF con datos
sf_municipios_datos <- sf_municipios |>
  left_join(df_municipios_completo, by = "id_municipio") |>
  mutate(pct_pt = replace_na(pct_pt, 0)) |>
  st_transform(crs = 4326)

# Agregación a nivel estado
df_estados_datos <- df_municipios_completo |>
  group_by(sigla_uf, region) |>
  summarise(
    n_municipios     = n(),
    population_total = sum(population,     na.rm = TRUE),
    gdp_pc_estado    = sum(gdp,            na.rm = TRUE) / sum(population, na.rm = TRUE),
    pct_pt_promedio  = mean(pct_pt,        na.rm = TRUE),
    transfer_pc      = sum(transfer_total, na.rm = TRUE) / sum(population, na.rm = TRUE),
    health_exp_pc    = sum(health_exp,     na.rm = TRUE) / sum(population, na.rm = TRUE),
    educ_exp_pc      = sum(educ_exp,       na.rm = TRUE) / sum(population, na.rm = TRUE),
    urban_exp_pc     = sum(urban_exp,      na.rm = TRUE) / sum(population, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups          = "drop"
  )

sf_estados_datos <- sf_estados |>
  left_join(df_estados_datos, by = "sigla_uf")

# Serie temporal por región
df_gasto_region <- df_finance |>
  left_join(df_municipalities |> select(id_municipio, region), by = "id_municipio") |>
  left_join(df_socioeconomic  |> select(id_municipio, year, population),
            by = c("id_municipio", "year")) |>
  filter(!is.na(region), !is.na(population), population > 0) |>
  group_by(year, region) |>
  summarise(
    health_exp_pc = sum(health_exp, na.rm = TRUE) / sum(population, na.rm = TRUE),
    educ_exp_pc   = sum(educ_exp,   na.rm = TRUE) / sum(population, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups       = "drop"
  )
```

# Mapa Electoral

## {.sidebar}

```{r}
#| label: sidebar-filtros

# SharedData sobre estados para vincular el mapa con el selector de región
shared_map <- SharedData$new(
  df_municipios_completo |>
    filter(!is.na(region)) |>
    select(id_municipio, region, sigla_uf),
  key = ~id_municipio
)

# Filtro de región (vinculado al mapa vía crosstalk)
filter_select(
  id       = "filtro_region",
  label    = "Filtrar por región",
  sharedData = shared_map,
  group    = ~region
)

# Filtro de estado
filter_select(
  id       = "filtro_estado",
  label    = "Filtrar por estado",
  sharedData = shared_map,
  group    = ~sigla_uf
)
```

---

**Nota:** el mapa muestra el % de votos al PT en las elecciones municipales 2020. Hacé click en un municipio para ver su detalle en la tabla de la derecha.

Los colores van del amarillo (bajo %) al rojo oscuro (alto %).

## Column {width="65%"}

```{r}
#| label: mapa-electoral
#| title: "% votos PT por municipio — Brasil 2020"

paleta_pt <- colorNumeric(
  palette  = "YlOrRd",
  domain   = sf_municipios_datos$pct_pt,
  na.color = "#CCCCCC"
)

leaflet(sf_municipios_datos) |>
  addProviderTiles(providers$CartoDB.Positron) |>
  addPolygons(
    fillColor   = ~paleta_pt(pct_pt),
    fillOpacity = 0.75,
    color       = "white",
    weight      = 0.4,
    opacity     = 1,
    highlight   = highlightOptions(
      weight       = 2,
      color        = "#444",
      fillOpacity  = 0.95,
      bringToFront = TRUE
    ),
    label = ~paste0(name_muni, " (", sigla_uf, ") — ", pct_pt, "% PT"),
    labelOptions = labelOptions(
      style    = list("font-size" = "12px", "font-weight" = "bold"),
      textsize = "12px"
    ),
    popup = ~paste0(
      "<div style='font-family:sans-serif; font-size:13px; min-width:160px'>",
      "<b style='font-size:14px'>", name_muni, "</b><br>",
      "<span style='color:#888'>", sigla_uf, " · ", region, "</span>",
      "<hr style='margin:4px 0'>",
      "<b>PT:</b> ", pct_pt, "%<br>",
      "<b>Población:</b> ", format(replace_na(population, 0),
                                   big.mark = ".", scientific = FALSE), "<br>",
      "<b>PBI pc:</b> R$ ", format(round(replace_na(gdp, 0) /
                                           pmax(replace_na(population, 1), 1)),
                                   big.mark = ".", scientific = FALSE),
      "</div>"
    ),
    layerId = ~id_municipio
  ) |>
  addLegend(
    position  = "bottomright",
    pal       = paleta_pt,
    values    = ~pct_pt,
    title     = "% PT",
    labFormat = labelFormat(suffix = "%"),
    opacity   = 0.85
  ) |>
  setView(lng = -52, lat = -15, zoom = 4)
```

## Column {width="35%"}

```{r}
#| label: tabla-municipios
#| title: "Detalle por municipio"

df_municipios_completo |>
  mutate(
    gdp_pc        = round(gdp        / pmax(population, 1), 0),
    health_exp_pc = round(health_exp / pmax(population, 1), 0),
    educ_exp_pc   = round(educ_exp   / pmax(population, 1), 0),
    transfer_pc   = round(transfer_total / pmax(population, 1), 0)
  ) |>
  arrange(desc(pct_pt)) |>
  select(
    Municipio     = name,
    Estado        = sigla_uf,
    Región        = region,
    `% PT`        = pct_pt,
    Población     = population,
    `PBI pc`      = gdp_pc,
    `Salud pc`    = health_exp_pc,
    `Educ. pc`    = educ_exp_pc,
    `Transf. pc`  = transfer_pc
  ) |>
  datatable(
    rownames   = FALSE,
    filter     = "top",
    extensions = "Buttons",
    options    = list(
      pageLength = 12,
      scrollX    = TRUE,
      dom        = "Bfrtip",
      buttons    = list("csv", "excel")
    )
  ) |>
  formatCurrency(
    columns  = c("PBI pc", "Salud pc", "Educ. pc", "Transf. pc"),
    currency = "R$ ", digits = 0, mark = "."
  ) |>
  formatStyle(
    "% PT",
    background         = styleColorBar(c(0, 60), "#FC8D59"),
    backgroundSize     = "98% 55%",
    backgroundRepeat   = "no-repeat",
    backgroundPosition = "center"
  )
```

# Gasto Fiscal

## Column

```{r}
#| label: scatter-gasto
#| title: "Gasto en salud vs. educación per cápita por estado (2020)"

df_scatter_gasto <- df_estados_datos |>
  filter(!is.na(health_exp_pc), !is.na(educ_exp_pc))

plot_ly(
  df_scatter_gasto,
  x         = ~health_exp_pc,
  y         = ~educ_exp_pc,
  color     = ~region,
  size      = ~population_total,
  text      = ~paste0(
    "<b>", sigla_uf, "</b><br>",
    "Salud pc: R$ ", format(round(health_exp_pc), big.mark = "."), "<br>",
    "Educ. pc: R$ ", format(round(educ_exp_pc),   big.mark = "."), "<br>",
    "Región: ", region
  ),
  hoverinfo = "text",
  type      = "scatter",
  mode      = "markers",
  marker    = list(opacity = 0.8, sizemode = "diameter")
) |>
  layout(
    xaxis  = list(title = "Gasto en salud pc (R$)",
                  tickformat = ",.0f"),
    yaxis  = list(title = "Gasto en educación pc (R$)",
                  tickformat = ",.0f"),
    legend = list(title = list(text = "Región")),
    # línea diagonal de referencia: igualdad salud = educación
    shapes = list(list(
      type = "line",
      x0   = min(df_scatter_gasto$health_exp_pc, na.rm = TRUE),
      x1   = max(df_scatter_gasto$health_exp_pc, na.rm = TRUE),
      y0   = min(df_scatter_gasto$health_exp_pc, na.rm = TRUE),
      y1   = max(df_scatter_gasto$health_exp_pc, na.rm = TRUE),
      line = list(color = "grey", dash = "dot", width = 1)
    ))
  )
```

## Column

```{r}
#| label: serie-temporal
#| title: "Evolución del gasto municipal per cápita por región (2013–2020)"

# Transformamos a formato largo para poder graficar salud y educación juntos
df_ts_largo <- df_gasto_region |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols      = c(health_exp_pc, educ_exp_pc),
    names_to  = "tipo",
    values_to = "gasto_pc"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    tipo  = recode(tipo,
                   health_exp_pc = "Salud",
                   educ_exp_pc   = "Educación"),
    label = paste0(region, " — ", tipo, "<br>",
                   "Año: ", year, "<br>",
                   "R$ ", format(round(gasto_pc), big.mark = "."))
  )

p_ts <- df_ts_largo |>
  ggplot(aes(
    x      = year,
    y      = gasto_pc,
    color  = region,
    linetype = tipo,
    text   = label
  )) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.9) +
  geom_point(size = 1.8) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = label_number(prefix = "R$ ", big.mark = ".")) +
  scale_linetype_manual(values = c("Salud" = "solid", "Educación" = "dashed")) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Gasto pc (R$)", color = "Región", linetype = NULL) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12)

ggplotly(p_ts, tooltip = "text", dynamicTicks = TRUE) |>
  rangeslider() |>
  layout(legend = list(orientation = "h", y = -0.25))
```

## Column {width="70%"}

```{r}
#| label: tabla-resumen-estados
#| title: "Indicadores por estado — semáforos de gasto"

df_tabla_resumen <- df_estados_datos |>
  mutate(across(c(gdp_pc_estado, transfer_pc, health_exp_pc,
                  educ_exp_pc, urban_exp_pc), ~ round(.x, 0)),
         pct_pt_promedio = round(pct_pt_promedio, 1)) |>
  arrange(desc(population_total)) |>
  select(
    Estado           = sigla_uf,
    Región           = region,
    `N municipios`   = n_municipios,
    Población        = population_total,
    `PBI pc (R$)`    = gdp_pc_estado,
    `% PT`           = pct_pt_promedio,
    `Transf. pc`     = transfer_pc,
    `Salud pc`       = health_exp_pc,
    `Educ. pc`       = educ_exp_pc
  )

reactable(
  df_tabla_resumen,
  searchable       = TRUE,
  striped          = TRUE,
  highlight        = TRUE,
  defaultPageSize  = 14,
  defaultSortOrder = "desc",
  defaultSorted    = "Población",
  columns = list(
    Estado        = colDef(maxWidth = 65),
    Región        = colDef(maxWidth = 110),
    `N municipios` = colDef(
      maxWidth = 100,
      format   = colFormat(separators = TRUE)
    ),
    Población     = colDef(format = colFormat(separators = TRUE)),
    `PBI pc (R$)` = colDef(
      format = colFormat(prefix = "R$ ", separators = TRUE, digits = 0),
      # Intensidad de azul proporcional al valor
      style  = function(value) {
        if (is.na(value)) return(list())
        rng   <- range(df_tabla_resumen$`PBI pc (R$)`, na.rm = TRUE)
        alpha <- round(0.15 + 0.75 * (value - rng[1]) / diff(rng), 2)
        list(background = paste0("rgba(52, 152, 219, ", alpha, ")"))
      }
    ),
    `% PT` = colDef(
      format = colFormat(suffix = "%", digits = 1),
      # Semáforo: rojo ≥ 20%, amarillo ≥ 12%, verde < 12%
      style  = function(value) {
        if (is.na(value)) return(list())
        color <- if (value >= 20) "#e74c3c" else if (value >= 12) "#f39c12" else "#2ecc71"
        list(background = color, color = "white",
             fontWeight = "bold", borderRadius = "4px")
      }
    ),
    `Transf. pc` = colDef(
      format = colFormat(prefix = "R$ ", separators = TRUE, digits = 0),
      # Intensidad de verde proporcional al valor
      style  = function(value) {
        if (is.na(value)) return(list())
        rng   <- range(df_tabla_resumen$`Transf. pc`, na.rm = TRUE)
        alpha <- round(0.12 + 0.75 * (value - rng[1]) / diff(rng), 2)
        list(background = paste0("rgba(39, 174, 96, ", alpha, ")"))
      }
    ),
    `Salud pc` = colDef(
      format = colFormat(prefix = "R$ ", separators = TRUE, digits = 0),
      # Intensidad de rojo proporcional al valor
      style  = function(value) {
        if (is.na(value)) return(list())
        rng   <- range(df_tabla_resumen$`Salud pc`, na.rm = TRUE)
        alpha <- round(0.12 + 0.75 * (value - rng[1]) / diff(rng), 2)
        list(background = paste0("rgba(192, 57, 43, ", alpha, ")"))
      }
    ),
    `Educ. pc` = colDef(
      format = colFormat(prefix = "R$ ", separators = TRUE, digits = 0),
      # Intensidad de naranja proporcional al valor
      style  = function(value) {
        if (is.na(value)) return(list())
        rng   <- range(df_tabla_resumen$`Educ. pc`, na.rm = TRUE)
        alpha <- round(0.12 + 0.75 * (value - rng[1]) / diff(rng), 2)
        list(background = paste0("rgba(211, 84, 0, ", alpha, ")"))
      }
    )
  )
)
```
